basic-button.name: GButton

props.name: typeNative
props.description:
same as native button's type link
`reset / button / submit`

props.name: autofocus
props.description:
Specifies that a button should automatically get focus when the page loads.

Only if the `href` is disabled.

props.name: href
props.description:
If you write an href the component behaves with an `a`.
Specifies the URL of the page the link goes to

props.name: target
props.description:
Specifies where to open the linked document.

Only if the `href` is active

props.name: download
props.description:
Specifies that the target will be downloaded when a user clicks on the hyperlink.

Only if the href is active.

props.name: title
props.description: Button title text (takes precedence over slot)

props.name: iconLeft
props.description:
Left icon rendered using the IconFont component.

The icon should be specified using the format "<weight> <icon-name>".
Acceptable weights are: "solid", "regular", "light", "brands", or "duotone".

props.name: iconRight
props.description:
Right icon rendered using the IconFont component.

The icon should be specified using the format "<weight> <icon-name>".
Acceptable weights are: "solid", "regular", "light", "brands", or "duotone".

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the button when the visual text is not descriptive enough
